verse.verse_1: When the heaven is cleft asunder (Infatarat).
verse.verse_5: A person will know what he has sent forward and left behind.
verse.verse_6: O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous
verse.verse_7: Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion.
verse.verse_8: In whatever form He willed, He put you together.
verse.verse_9: Nay! But you deny (the Day of) Ad-Din.
verse.verse_10: But verily, over you to watch you
verse.verse_12: They know all that you do.
verse.verse_13: Verily, the Abrar (the righteous believers) will be in Delight;
verse.verse_14: And verily, the wicked will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),
verse.verse_15: Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,
verse.verse_16: And they will not be absent therefrom.
verse.verse_17: And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is
verse.verse_18: Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is
verse.verse_19: (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be with Allah.
